---
title: "what is the wing area and aspect ratio at the optimum?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
captured_args = {}
orig_build = optimize_glider.__globals__['build_glider']

def hooked_build(c_root, c_tip, x_wing, ballast_mass=0.0):
    captured_args.update(dict(c_root=c_root, c_tip=c_tip, x_wing=x_wing, ballast_mass=ballast_mass))
    return orig_build(c_root, c_tip, x_wing, ballast_mass)

optimize_glider.__globals__['build_glider'] = hooked_build
sol, _ = optimize_glider()
optimize_glider.__globals__['build_glider'] = orig_build

_, opt_wing, _ = build_glider(
    sol(captured_args['c_root']),
    sol(captured_args['c_tip']),
    sol(captured_args['x_wing']),
    sol(captured_args['ballast_mass'])
)

opt_area = opt_wing.area()
opt_ar = opt_wing.aspect_ratio()
```

::: {.hero-pair}
[`{python} f"{opt_area:.3f}"` m²]{.hero-value}
[wing area]{.hero-label}

[`{python} f"{opt_ar:.2f}"`]{.hero-value}
[aspect ratio]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The optimized fixed-span glider has a wing area of `{python} f"{opt_area:.3f}"` m² and an aspect ratio of `{python} f"{opt_ar:.2f}"`. The optimizer may slide the taper ratio slightly across runs, finding different tip and root chords, but it preserves this optimal area and aspect ratio.

```{python}
#| echo: false

footer(optimize_glider)
```
